subtopics: the 1-bit slice: a full adder, an AND gate and an OR gate feeding one output multiplexer
function selection: two select bits giving four functions, and the code rather than the data deciding the operation
subtraction as the same adder with B inverted and the carry in held at 1
the result bit, the carry out and the four status flags Z, N, C and V

example.add_check: 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 = binary 11, so sum bit 1 and carry out 1
example.sub_check: 1 + (NOT 1) + 1 = 1 + 0 + 1 = 2 = binary 10, so sum bit 0 and carry out 1
example.sub_is_a_minus_b_for_one_bit: 1 - 1 = 0, and the slice gives result bit 0
